design.study: Separate fresh-seed null-size audit of fixed-scale and studentized family tests
design.status: Frozen before evaluation of this fresh seed bank; motivated by exploratory reviewer diagnostics
design.pairing: Same datasets and stationary indices across bootstrap methods; same trial addresses across sample sizes; do not pool sample-size cells
design.oracle: Exact equicorrelated Gaussian maximum cutoff by quadrature and finite-n stationary AR mean variance
design.uncertainty: Wilson 95% binomial intervals per method; paired normal interval for studentized-minus-fixed rejection rate
design.selection: No method selection, no primary-result substitution, no block/HAC tuning; retain all outcomes
design.scope: Gaussian zero-mean six-candidate null only; does not establish uniform size control for 13 empirical portfolios, nonstationarity or heavy tails
design.runtime_choice: 499 inner replicates and 1000 outer trials fixed after a timing-only benchmark, before fresh-seed outcomes; primary empirical run retains 2000 replicates
design.pre_execution_review: Seed banks separated by 10000000 after reviewer detected overlap in draft addresses; corrected before any fresh audit outcome

presentation_revision.scope: Introductory report prose only; all numerical calculations, retained data and figures unchanged.
